description: Source code for a library implementing Generic Netlink communication, including message construction, parsing, validation, and socket connection functions.

methods.name: genl_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection on a netlink socket to the generic netlink family.

methods.name: genl_send_simple
methods.description: Constructs and sends a simple generic netlink message with specified command, version, and flags.

methods.name: genlmsg_valid_hdr
methods.description: Validates the header of a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_validate
methods.description: Validates a generic netlink message against expected length and policy.

methods.name: genlmsg_parse
methods.description: Parses attributes from a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data payload of a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_len
methods.description: Returns the length of the payload in a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_attrdata
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the attribute data within a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_attrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of attribute data within a generic netlink message.

methods.name: genlmsg_put
methods.description: Adds a generic netlink header to a netlink message and returns a pointer to the user-specific header area.
